messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Users cannot find familiar locations in the claims module after the recent update.
  quote: Hi Bryn, we’re having some trouble navigating the claims module after the last update — things aren’t where we left them.
- problem: The reserves tab on the claims dashboard moved without any notice or guidance, causing confusion.
  quote: Well, the issue is that last week the claims dashboard suddenly shifted where the reserves tab sits — no heads-up, no training notes, nothing.
- problem: The customer cannot access the reserves dashboard after a recent update.
  quote: Hi Bryn, I’m Quenna from Penhallow Specialty Risks — we’re having trouble accessing our reserves dashboard after the update last week.
